description.en: Simulation-Driven Mechanical Engineering Portfolio — Computational Mechanics, Mechanical Design, Engineering Automation
description.zh: 仿真驱动机械工程作品集 — 计算力学 · 机械设计 · 工程自动化

subtitle.en: Combining physics-based simulation, mechanical design, and engineering automation to develop reliable solutions through numerical analysis, optimization, and digital workflows.
subtitle.zh: 结合计算力学、机械设计与工程自动化，通过数值模拟、结构优化和数字化工作流解决复杂工程问题。

desc.en: Each domain represents a distinct methodology and toolchain, unified by rigorous physics-based reasoning and computational thinking.
desc.zh: 每个领域代表一种独特的方法论和工具链，统一于严谨的物理推理和计算思维。

desc.en: FEA, nonlinear mechanics, and numerical simulation — applying finite element methods to predict structural response, failure modes, and material behavior under complex loading.
desc.zh: 有限元分析、非线性力学与数值模拟，利用计算方法预测结构响应、材料行为以及复杂载荷下的工程性能。

desc.en: CAD modeling, mechanical structures, and design optimization — from conceptual design to manufacturable engineering solutions.
desc.zh: 机械结构设计、CAD建模与设计优化，覆盖概念设计、工程验证以及面向制造的机械解决方案。

desc.en: Python-based engineering automation, parametric modeling, and simulation workflow development — improving efficiency through computational tools.
desc.zh: 基于Python的工程自动化、参数化建模与仿真流程开发，提升工程分析效率与设计迭代能力。

desc.en: A curated selection of computational and design projects demonstrating analytical rigor, simulation methodology, and engineering problem-solving.
desc.zh: 精选计算与设计项目，展示分析严谨性、仿真方法论和工程问题解决能力。

emptyDesc.en: A selection of engineering projects is currently being prepared. Each project page will include detailed methodology, results, and technical insights.
emptyDesc.zh: 一批工程项目正在准备中。每个项目页面将包含详细的方法论、结果与技术洞察。

desc.en: Applying finite element analysis and numerical methods to solve structural mechanics, heat transfer, and coupled-field problems with validated computational models.
desc.zh: 应用有限元分析和数值方法解决结构力学、传热和耦合场问题，使用经过验证的计算模型。

desc.en: Parametric design space exploration, structural topology optimization, and multi-objective optimization for lightweight, high-performance engineering components.
desc.zh: 参数化设计空间探索、结构拓扑优化和多目标优化，实现轻量化高性能工程组件。

desc.en: Full digital workflow from CAD modeling to simulation-driven iteration, reducing physical prototyping cycles and accelerating design convergence.
desc.zh: 从CAD建模到仿真驱动迭代的完整数字化工作流，减少物理原型周期，加速设计收敛。

desc.en: Python-based workflow automation for simulation pre/post-processing, parametric studies, and batch analysis — transforming repetitive tasks into efficient scripts.
desc.zh: 基于Python的工作流自动化，涵盖仿真前后处理、参数化研究和批量分析 — 将重复性任务转化为高效脚本。

desc.en: Post-processing, uncertainty quantification, and statistical validation of simulation results for robust engineering conclusions.
desc.zh: 仿真结果的后处理、不确定性量化和统计验证，为工程结论提供可靠依据。

desc.en: End-to-end automation of simulation pipelines, coupling FEA solvers with optimization frameworks and visualization tools.
desc.zh: 仿真管道的端到端自动化，将FEA求解器与优化框架和可视化工具耦合。
